papers.title: COMPASS: A Framework for Evaluating Organization-Specific Policy Alignment in LLMs

training_data.name: Policy-aware SFT dataset
training_data.quote: Responses were selected from model outputs that achieved full policy adherence under COMPASS evaluation.

training_method.objective_quote: The SFT dataset comprises 4,121 query-response pairs from the remaining 7 domains, where responses were selected from outputs achieving full policy adherence in our main experiments.
training_method.update_scope_quote: Method: LoRA adapters. Quantization: 8-bit during training.

source_claims.quote: We trained LoRA adapters for 3 epochs with rank r=64, α=128, peak LR 5×10−4 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct

description.text: This repository provides a **LoRA adapter** trained for **organization-specific policy adherence** in the COMPASS framework.

serving.text_only_input_quote: prompt = "Give me a short introduction to large language model."
serving.system_prompt: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
serving.notes: This card has no usage example. The text-only quote is from the parent card Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, which generates from a text prompt. config.json architecture is Qwen2ForCausalLM. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja. generation_config.json and adapter_config.json return HTTP 404. The repository stores four full safetensors shards (7,615,616,512 BF16 parameters) and no adapter weights file. config.json sets unsloth_version to 2025.11.3.

evaluation_reported.text: On held-out TelePath, the card's Policy Alignment Score for LODO SFT (LoRA) is Allowed Base 96.67, Allowed Edge 89.52, Denied Base 71.74, Denied Edge 60.49. The same table lists the base system prompt at 96.67, 85.71, 24.00, and 0.00. Appendix G.3 of the paper prints the same four LODO scores.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are lora|sft. The card and paper state LoRA trained with 8-bit quantization, which this record codes as qlora, plus SFT. The dataset id and parent match. The card calls the repository a LoRA adapter, but the file list is a full model: four safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json. The card body links AIM-Intelligence/COMPASS-Policy-aware-SFT, which redirects to AIM-Intelligence/COMPASS-Policy-aware-SFT-Dataset.
